title: Add targeted backend tests for builder and parser parity
acceptance_criteria: Targeted tests cover native Orderly request building for single TP, single SL, and paired TP+SL submission.
Targeted tests cover parser or mapper behavior for regular orders, algo orders, websocket acknowledgements, and native fee or liquidation fields.
Test fixtures or helpers keep Decimal-sensitive assertions explicit and deterministic.
Validation steps include running only the new targeted test modules successfully.
